habitat: Broadleaved forest; forest edges; mature secondary growth; dry coastal forest; and mangroves
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Firery Minivet (Pericrocotus igneus) stands out. This species, part of the Campephagidae family, is a resident of Broadleaved forest; forest edges; mature secondary growth; dry coastal forest; and mangroves. Its IUCN Red List status is Near Threatened (NT), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Firery Minivet is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Firery Minivet and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
